title: Weekly briefing — Mon Nov 9, 2026
summary: Let's start there. On Sunday, Nvidia's board said it is opening an independent investigation into chief executive Jensen Huang. What triggered it? Reporting, led by the New York Times, that US officials believe a former executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore data center firm, was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security. Reports say she and Huang had a relationship. She is no relation, despite sharing the surname. And these are reports, not findings. No one has been charged.
